headword: {駐車場代|ちゅうしゃじょうだい}
reading: ちゅうしゃじょうだい

definitions.gloss: parking fee; parking lot charge; cost of parking
definitions.explanation: The fee charged for using a parking lot or parking space. In Japan, parking is rarely free, especially in urban areas, making this a common everyday expense.

examples.japanese: {駐車場代|ちゅうしゃじょうだい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いくらです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How much is the parking fee?

examples.japanese: ⟦{都心|としん}→都心：04072_toshin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{駐車場代|ちゅうしゃじょうだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Parking fees are expensive in the city center.

examples.japanese: ⟦{月極|つきぎめ}→月極：13000_tsukigime⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{駐車場代|ちゅうしゃじょうだい}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧{三万円|さんまんえん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: The monthly parking fee alone costs 30,000 yen per month.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧ (parking lot) and ⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧ (charge, fee — the same suffix as in ⟦{電気代|でんきだい}→電気代：09543_denkidai⟧, {食事代|しょくじだい}). A practical term that comes up frequently in daily life and travel in Japan.

In urban Japan, especially Tokyo, monthly parking (⟦{月極|つきぎめ}{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→月極駐車場：19061_tsukigimechuushajou⟧) can cost as much as apartment rent in some areas. This is one reason why car ownership rates are lower in major cities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駐車場代|ちゅうしゃじょうだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: parking costs money
- {駐車場代|ちゅうしゃじょうだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay for parking
- ⟦{月極|つきぎめ}→月極：13000_tsukigime⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{駐車場代|ちゅうしゃじょうだい}: monthly parking fee
- {駐車場代|ちゅうしゃじょうだい}⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧: parking fee included

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{駐車料金|ちゅうしゃりょうきん}→駐車料金：07815_chuusharyoukin⟧: parking charge — more formal, often on signs
- ⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧: parking lot — the place itself
- ⟦{路上駐車|ろじょうちゅうしゃ}→路上駐車：24063_rojouchuusha⟧: street parking — parking on the road
